title: [Miao medicine Sidaxue regulates macrophage polarization and alleviates synovial inflammation in collagen-induced arthritis rats by inhibiting HIF-1alpha/PDK1-mediated glycolytic reprogramming].
authors: Shen, Wanting; Chen, Yizhe; Fu, Xinyu; Yuan, Jiatao; Zhou, Jun; Huang, Li; Wu, Ning
journal: Nan fang yi ke da xue xue bao = Journal of Southern Medical University
one_liner_zh: 该文研究苗药SX通过抑制HIF-1alpha/PDK1糖酵解重编程调节巨噬细胞极化缓解关节炎，虽涉及AlphaFold3和分子对接，但核心是药物抗炎机制，非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合体系，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: OBJECTIVES: To investigate the mechanism of Miao medicine prescription Sidaxue (SX) for inhibiting glycolysis in the synovial tissue and promoting macrophage polarization in rats with collagen-induced arthritis (CIA). METHODS: Thirty-two SD rats were randomized into normal control group, CIA model group, tripterygium glycosides (40 mg/kg; positive control) treatment group, and SX (40 g/kg) treatment group (n=8). Except for those in the normal control group, all the rats were subjected to CIA modeling and treated with saline, tripterygium glycosides or SX by gavage for 21 consecutive days. Paw swelling, arthritis index, synovial pathology, inflammatory factors, glycolysis-related indicators and gene expressions were detected. UHPLC-MS was used to screen the components of SX in the blood of SX-treated rats. The target genes of the active components of SX and rheumatoid arthritis (RA) were predicted using bioinformatics analysis, and the hub genes were identified using machine learning algorithms. The binding sites between HIF-1alpha and PDK1 were predicted using AlphaFold3, and the interactions between SX components and their targets were simulated using molecular docking. RESULTS: SX treatment significantly alleviated joint swelling, lowered arthritis scores, improved synovial lesions, and reduced serum levels of TNF-alpha, IL-1beta and IL-6 in CIA rats, resulting in also inhibition of macrophage polarization and down-regulation of HIF-1alpha, PDK1 and HK2 expressions in the synovial tissues. Twenty-nine components of SX were detected in the blood of SX-treated rats, and 9 key target genes were identified. AlphaFold3 predicted a strong interaction between HIF-1alpha and PDK1, and their virtual knockout was shown to disturb the inflammatory pathways in the macrophages. Molecular docking studies suggested stable docking between the active components of SX and their key targets. CONCLUSIONS: SX alleviates joint inflammation in CIA rats by inhibiting the HIF-1alpha/PDK1 signaling pathway, correcting glycolytic reprogramming, and promoting M2 polarization of macrophages.
abstract_zh: 目的：探讨苗药四达血（SX）抑制胶原诱导性关节炎（CIA）大鼠滑膜组织糖酵解及促进巨噬细胞极化的机制。方法：将32只SD大鼠随机分为正常对照组、CIA模型组、雷公藤多苷（40 mg/kg；阳性对照）治疗组和SX（40 g/kg）治疗组（n=8）。除正常对照组外，所有大鼠均进行CIA建模，并分别用生理盐水、雷公藤多苷或SX连续灌胃21天。检测足爪肿胀度、关节炎指数、滑膜病理、炎症因子、糖酵解相关指标及基因表达。采用UHPLC-MS筛选SX治疗大鼠血液中的SX成分。利用生物信息学分析预测SX活性成分及类风湿关节炎（RA）的靶基因，并通过机器学习算法识别核心基因。使用AlphaFold3预测HIF-1α与PDK1之间的结合位点，并通过分子对接模拟SX成分与其靶标之间的相互作用。结果：SX治疗显著减轻CIA大鼠关节肿胀、降低关节炎评分、改善滑膜病变，并降低血清中TNF-α、IL-1β和IL-6水平，同时抑制巨噬细胞极化并下调滑膜组织中HIF-1α、PDK1和HK2的表达。在SX治疗大鼠血液中检测到29种SX成分，并识别出9个关键靶基因。AlphaFold3预测HIF-1α与PDK1之间存在强相互作用，其虚拟敲除显示可干扰巨噬细胞中的炎症通路。分子对接研究表明SX活性成分与其关键靶标之间具有稳定对接。结论：SX通过抑制HIF-1α/PDK1信号通路、纠正糖酵解重编程及促进巨噬细胞M2极化，减轻CIA大鼠关节炎症。
